Only the later 'duplicated' construction (lines 217-220) is actually tested. Harmless, but the first construction adds an 'owner' key, not a duplicate, so it would not exercise the duplicate-key guard even if parsed.

The 8fmacpgy identities.control_candidate field embeds an editorial parenthetical ('(the control the rolling queue currently names as frozen)') instead of a bare identity token. Distinctness and cross-run identity separation still hold, but a bare-token field would be cleaner for automated identity matching.

Until this batch itself is committed, the only byte-identity pins for the two bound files live inside untracked candidate files (the note section 1 and the test constants); no tracked artifact attests them. The tracked checks.json deliberately carries no SHA (non-attestation semantics), so the pin chain is self-referential within the batch until commit. Same accepted structural property as the prior context batches.
